Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Kunal - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Riya - 13 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Meenakshi - 35 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Vinod - 41 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
5. Siya - 10 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi and Vinod stand near him.]

Vinod: "Let's do something fun today."

[Kunal runs to Mother.]

Kunal: "What happened?"

[Kunal hides behind the tree.]

Kunal: "And then?"

[Kunal searches for his lost ball.]

Vinod: "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Riya stands in the living room. Kunal, Meenakshi and Vinod stand near her.]

Vinod: "So, here we are!"

[Riya puts on red lipstick.]

Riya (excited): "Show me too!"

[Kunal takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Vinod: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Kunal sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Kunal: "Hmm, I see."

[Kunal mops the floor.]

Vinod (excited): "Meenakshi, look at this."

[Kunal reads a storybook.]

Meenakshi: "That was fun!"

[Kunal talks to his father on the phone.]

Meenakshi (laughing): "Okay, Vinod."

[Kunal sits down on a chair.]

Riya (softly): "What a day to remember!"
